briefHtml:
Portfolio Brief — Thu 2026-10-08 (SGT)

  • NAV S$10,287,325 (−0.30% reported; ≈ −0.02% real vs restated base). Listed sleeve −1.67%. Restatement night 10: Oct 7 revised to S$10,288,911 (−S$11,155).
  • Biggest mover: metals/miners — GDX −3.13%, SILJ −3.91%, SLVP −3.68% as silver broke $60 late US ($59.68 at 7pm ET); CDL +2.58% snapped its 7-day skid while OCBC −5.9% (Citi downgrade) dragged STI −1.63%.
  • One thing: hawkish FOMC minutes (all backed Sep hike, most want another by year-end) pushed 30y to 5.70% intraday; December hike 83–87% priced; The Atlantic reports Trump weighing another Iran strike before midterms. Mainland China returns TODAY.

State

  • riskFlags EMPTY — 7-session stale-flag streak over; watcher baselines finally current. L46.SI 404, 20th session.
  • FX: USDSGD 1.2794 (SGD softer 2nd day), USDCNY ≈6.695, USDHKD ≈7.847.

Overnight

  • US: SPX 7,801.77 −0.22% (held 7,800), Nasdaq −0.22%, Dow −0.66% (CAT −5.7%), RUT −1.31%, VIX 15.08. 10y hit ~5.37% (24-yr high) then ~5.28%; 30y touched 5.70%, closed 5.66%. NY Fed 1-yr inflation expectations 3.9% (prev 3.6%).
  • HK: HSI 24,130.50 −0.62%, turnover HK$94.7bn (3rd sub-100bn). Tencent 420.60 −1.8% — 425 lost again. Xiaomi −1.3%, SMIC −1.1%. Stock Connect 5-day: Tencent largest inflow increase (+RMB1.379bn), SMIC largest decline (−RMB1.579bn).
  • SGX: STI 5,608.44 −1.63%. OCBC −5.9% (Citi sell), UOB −2.9%, DBS −1.4% (77.49). CDL 7.17 +2.58% — streak ended, 7.00 reclaimed. Hongkong Land +2.7% top gainer.
  • Metals: silver $59.68 late US (broke $60); gold 2-month low ~$4,096–4,134. GDX 85.46 −3.13%, SILJ 26.27 −3.91%, SLVP 33.81 −3.68%. PBoC 23rd straight month buying; LBMA sees $5,013/12mo. WTI settled −$1.16 at $88.28.

Insider / Congress

  • Wing Tai: Oct 6 filings (Change in Interests of Director + Grant of Share Awards) remain latest; director accumulation running through the property drawdown. IR page
  • Congress new: Doggett (D, TX-37) buys HD/IBM/JNJ/PPG $1–15K each (dividend reinvests); Fong (R, CA-20) buys T-bill $15–50K; Senate Dem (PA) 2x Dell bond buys. In-window: OH-6 (GS buy, MSFT/WFC sells), CA-11 (REOF $500K–1M). Unusual Whales

Policy watch

  • FOMC minutes hawkish: most see another hike by year-end; Dec 83–87%. Trump: Warsh is “one vote”. Newsquawk
  • Iran: Trump weighs pre-midterm strike (Atlantic), Pentagon crafting options; mediation stalled; Hormuz incidents daily; Iran-Oman safe-route coordinates agreed.
  • Trade/tech: FCC votes Oct 29 on barring Chinese labs from device testing; EU preps cap on Chinese hybrid cars after China rejected restraint (FT); UK TiO2 anti-dumping.
  • AI: AI czar Jay Clayton tours Silicon Valley; Trump at Thursday “super intelligence” summit; Samsung HBM4E reportedly passed NVDA qualification.

Risk

  • Rates shock is master risk: 30y 5.70% intraday, Dec hike 83–87%, inflation expectations 3.9%.
  • SG banks derating on “misplaced Singdollar-rate optimism” — read-across to DBS into Nov results.
  • Silver line: 1,777 oz ≈ S$135.7k vs S$56.24k loan → equity ≈ S$79.5k, ~1.71x; −4% silver day ≈ −6.8% equity; $59–60 is the must-hold zone.
  • FX ~35% non-SGD; HK liquidity air pocket (3rd sub-100bn session) into mainland return.

Alpha (signals, not advice)

  • HK verdict day: mainland returns; Tencent reclaim of 425 on southbound volume = add trigger; SMIC outflow continuing = defer semis leg.
  • SG property vs banks: CDL 7.00 reclaim + Citi bank derating — relative deployment only after a 2–3 day hold proves.
  • Real assets washout: structural bid (PBoC, LBMA $5,013) meets duration pain at $59–60 silver — stabilization = scale-in signal for 20% target; break of $59 defers.

trumpWatch.title: FOMC minutes hawkish: most see another hike by year-end; December 83–87% priced
trumpWatch.detail: All participants backed the 25bp September hike; most assessed another increase likely appropriate by year-end; almost all saw inflation risks tilted to the upside. October hike odds ~17–20%. NY Fed survey: 1-year inflation expectations jumped to 3.9% from 3.6%. Trump: "Warsh is great, but he’s one vote" — rates should come down.

trumpWatch.title: Trump weighs another Iran strike before the midterms (The Atlantic)
trumpWatch.detail: White House asked the Pentagon to develop strike options against Iranian targets usable ahead of the midterms; no final decision. Mediation stalled (Al Hadath); Hormuz no longer a Washington priority after Iran lost control of it (Al Arabiya). Iran-Oman agreed safe-route coordinates; IRGC says the strait stays closed; explosions reported in Hormuz; UKMTO incident off Qatar with casualties; Saudi-Syria discussing Syrian troops for Yemen (Axios).

trumpWatch.title: Trade/tech: FCC to vote on barring Chinese labs; EU preps hybrid-car cap
trumpWatch.detail: FCC votes Oct 29 on barring Chinese labs from testing smartphones, cameras and computers for the US market. EU preparing a temporary import cap on Chinese hybrid cars after China rejected voluntary export restraint (FT). UK imposing anti-dumping measures on Chinese rutile TiO2. USTR joint statement from 12 G20 countries plus EU/Poland on eliminating excess capacity.

trumpWatch.title: AI policy: AI czar Clayton tours Silicon Valley; Trump at "super intelligence" summit
trumpWatch.detail: New AI czar Jay Clayton to visit AI firms in Silicon Valley; Trump attends a Thursday summit meant to position the US as leader in breakthroughs driven by "super intelligence" (Axios). Samsung HBM4E 12-layer reportedly passed NVIDIA and hyperscaler quality verification (volumes/timing unconfirmed).

trumpWatch.title: Oil: WTI settles $88.28 (−$1.16); IEA accelerating ~100M bbl reserve releases
trumpWatch.detail: EIA crude −3.2M bbl vs +1.7M expected; SPR fell 0.8M to 283M. IEA members support accelerating the ~100M bbl collective release; France to release 10M bbl of diesel; Qatar Northfield East first LNG train ready (first gas November); third Syrian pipeline sabotage in ~10 days; Iraq trucking crude across Syria.

trumpWatch.title: Trump-Putin call "set up" (Kremlin: not agreed); WFC fair-lending probe
trumpWatch.detail: Trump said he has a call set up with Putin; the Kremlin said no call has been agreed. Zelensky said Ukrainian forces struck four Russian targets including two oil facilities. Trump administration housing officials are investigating whether Wells Fargo’s Black-homeownership efforts violated fair-lending laws (WSJ).

opportunities.thesis: Mainland returns from Golden Week today. Tencent (420.60) lost 425 pre-return, but 5-day Stock Connect data shows mainland money rotating toward platforms (Tencent +RMB1.379bn, largest increase) and away from semis (SMIC −RMB1.579bn, largest decline).
opportunities.signal: A Tencent reclaim of 425 on real southbound volume is the add trigger; continued SMIC southbound outflow defers the semis leg. Today’s tape resets the HK map.

opportunities.thesis: CDL ended its 7-session skid and reclaimed 7.00 on the value-unlock plan the same day Citi derated the banks on "misplaced optimism on Singdollar rates" (OCBC −5.9%). Wing Tai insiders kept buying through the slide.
opportunities.signal: Property-over-banks relative deployment only after the 7.00 reclaim holds 2–3 sessions; one bounce is not a trend.

opportunities.thesis: Rates-driven washout: miners −3 to −4%, silver broke $60 late US, gold at a 2-month low as 30y touched 5.70%. Against it: PBoC 23rd straight month buying, LBMA $5,013 12-month forecast, live pre-midterm Iran-strike optionality.
opportunities.signal: Structural bid meets duration pain at $59–60 silver — a stabilization print is the scale-in signal for the 20% real-assets target; a decisive break below $59 defers the next tranche.
